## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: Pre-filter via .gitattributes linguist tags + additive ignore.glob/regex. Non-empty defaults. max_files / max_calls non-zero validation.

## Implementation Notes
Create `tests/scripts/test_dso_ci_review_file_filter.py` (pytest):
- linguist-generated, linguist-vendored, linguist-documentation tagged files in .gitattributes are filtered OUT
- ignore.glob default values present (package-lock.json, yarn.lock, poetry.lock, go.sum) — match the documented defaults
- ignore.glob/regex additive on top of linguist tags (NOT replacing)
- Config load with max_files=0 emits a warning
- Config load with max_calls=0 emits a warning  
- Test returns (reviewable_files, skipped_files_with_reasons) tuple

Add `.test-index` RED marker `[test_dso_ci_review_file_filter]`.

## File Impact
| Source file | Action | Tests | Class |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tests/scripts/test_dso_ci_review_file_filter.py` | create | (this IS the test) | needs-creation |
| `.test-index` | modify | n/a | marker |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Test exists and is RED
  Verify: test -f tests/scripts/test_dso_ci_review_file_filter.py && ! pytest tests/scripts/test_dso_ci_review_file_filter.py
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker
  Verify: grep '\[test_dso_ci_review_file_filter\]' \$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet); escalate to opus then user.
